title: Codex information-display evidence map
objective: Establish how current Codex CLI and app surfaces present reasoning, tool calls, command output, approvals, diffs, progress, errors, and multi-agent activity, including what is condensed and what remains inspectable.

include: Current Codex manual fetched through the openai-docs workflow
Official OpenAI Codex documentation and open-source CLI code where public
Slash commands, transcript controls, notifications, approvals, and non-interactive output
exclude: Treating API event schemas as proof of a particular UI rendering

deliverables: A catalog of user controls for expanding, reviewing, or navigating evidence
Clearly marked gaps where public documentation does not specify UI heuristics
acceptance_criteria: Uses the current Codex manual as the first source
Distinguishes CLI, app, IDE, and exec/non-interactive output
Separates product behavior from recommendations for this Go project
verification: Every material product claim has an official URL, manual line range, or official repository reference

result.summary: Source-backed Codex display behavior matrix covering display/transcript/raw projections, command cells, reasoning, patches, and subagent threads.
